resources.string: Control small-window mode with Shell commands. Copy a command to use it in a gesture, shortcut, automation or terminal.
Enable NeXtep in LSPosed and restart the device for it to take effect. Run the commands with Root permission while the phone is unlocked.
Exit when active; enter otherwise. Copy the complete script.
Keep the current workspace if it is already active.
Keep normal mode if the workspace is already closed.
1: small-window mode; 0: normal mode; null: no state recorded yet.
Copy the command you need and paste it into a Shell or custom-command action. Do not add an adb shell prefix.
Select Root execution and grant permission to the tool running the command. In a phone terminal, run su first, then paste the command.
Bind Enter and Exit to separate gestures or shortcuts and save them.
